verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Render can issue short-lived OIDC tokens for its own services to authenticate outbound to Anthropic/OpenAI (render-docs-30), but nothing documents integrating an organization's own identity provider (SSO/SAML/OIDC) to authenticate users or gate access to internal apps, deployments, or agents on Render. No mention of SSO, SAML, Okta/Azure AD integration, or team-level IdP-based access control appears anywhere in the pack.
